metadataScheduling.observedDirectoryCoverage: Every witness scope contains exactly two matching owner-created/after-action reads; every hide scope contains six. No extra directory producer is observed within these drained intervals.
metadataScheduling.durationDefinition: reserved/drained/ended uptime differences separate queueing, drain and ownership. Logged durationMS begins before acquisition queueing and is not the held duration.
metadataScheduling.priorityLimit: Priority17 held-refresh witness reads own explicit scopes. Priority alone does not identify an unauthorized background read.

switchLatencyMS.measurement: R4 press to two matching physical readbacks

clickTimeline.name: d866/full
notes: All additive timeline intervals are clipped to external AX press start and the fixture's second physical confirmation.
Witness trace durations include nested directory and physical reads; no nested totals are added twice.
Task-exit stamp precedes final trace serialization/write; the caller gap does not identify its blocking cause.
Ordinary focus is an inferred envelope including WAL and guards, not a measured pure AX focus duration.
Elapsed intervals do not prove CPU occupancy or exclude sampling perturbation.
Candidate host and overview reader started before the measured click; their earlier startup is not charged to the click.

detail.limitation: Upper bound including journal/guards; no isolated focus start/end trace.

limitations: No population latency or reliability inference from this finite sequence.
Witness/read/role/permission timings are nested elapsed intervals and cannot be added indiscriminately.
An external double read may precede final Coordinator verification and journal commit.
No new diagnostic field is treated as a window-write permit.

journalEvidence.limit: Only the final ledger is preserved. No independent intermediate WAL timestamps are available. Scope end follows existing full post confirmation/sealed after-image code; successful group-choice exit follows activation return. The empty cleanup ledger alone does not prove earlier commit.

firstUnfulfilledInput.observed: The second actual AX press reaches the still-displayed current-card/choose-group handlers with appearance/lifetime absent and stillGrouped=false. No second navigation submission or product SHOW follows. The first transaction subsequently completes. The hidden windows correctly lack ordinary appearance lifetimes; their original retained AX ownership is independently confirmed by the complete witnesses and cleanup.
firstUnfulfilledInput.limit: The second press occurs during final verification, before the first transaction completes. The later complete/fresh revision50 correctly lacks ordinary/group lifetimes for the hidden windows, but does not establish that the old current UI remains clickable after completion. There is no third, post-completion click in this run. No navigation-busy rejection or second engine post-write failure is recorded.

latency.nestedTimingLimit: Role, permission, native and witness phases are nested intervals. The non-overlapping physical-confirmation timeline is separately provided; do not add its envelopes to nested diagnostic totals.

interpretationClarification.reason: Distinguish normal hidden-window appearance expiry from the observed pre-completion current-to-held click handoff; do not infer a persistent post-completion UI failure from revision50.
